title: Accomplishments, with the record behind them.
intro: Jason Colapietro’s engineering record, books, shipped apps and program memberships come first, then Suede AI’s coverage and recognition. Each entry links to the underlying record.

records.title: 54 merged pull requests. 46 external repositories.
records.body: As of September 2026, the public record shows 54 pull requests merged across 46 external repositories Jason does not maintain: 33 substantive code or documentation contributions and 21 accepted listings of Jason-owned work. Maintainers have merged contributions into projects including Jest, Adobe React Spectrum, Backstage, the Polkadot SDK, Hardhat, the x402 Foundation and zeroclaw. A separate Linux kernel USB/IP patch is at Public upstream v7 and under review; it is not counted. Adobe React Spectrum #10426 was merged and later replaced by #10491, so it is recorded as a historical contribution, not a currently shipped API.

records.title: A feature in Adobe’s design system, and fixes in Backstage, Hardhat, zeroclaw, and the Polkadot SDK
records.body: The contributions to lead with: a public useShowFocusIndicator hook accepted into Adobe React Spectrum by a core maintainer; a catalog-graph fix in Backstage, the CNCF developer-portal framework; removal of the retired Holesky chain descriptor from Hardhat, merged by a project lead; a daemon socket-ownership fix in the zeroclaw runtime, 767 lines of Rust across two crates; an RPC capacity-release fix in the Polkadot SDK; and two Jest fixes, one isolating virtual mock module IDs and one tolerating a transient watcher error.

records.title: Listed in fifteen independent skills directories and the x402 ecosystem list
records.body: Suede Creator Skills, the public Claude Code skills marketplace, has been accepted by the maintainers of fifteen independent awesome-lists and directories, including buildwithclaude, awesome-codex, awesome-agent-skills, and awesome-claude-code-plugins. Suede AI Agent Studio is listed in the x402 ecosystem’s awesome-x402. These accepted listings are counted inside the 54 merged pull requests above and are stated separately so the composition stays clear.

records.title: Five books on Amazon Kindle, led by two engineering guides
records.body: The Claude Code Bible and Codex in Production, Jason’s operator guides to AI coding agents, lead a five-book Amazon Kindle catalog that also holds Proof as Infrastructure, Stake Your Claim and The Human Authenticity Layer. The two operator guides were republished on KDP as Edition 2 on September 4, 2026. He also publishes The Screenshot, free to read on the web with its source edition on GitHub, and The Signal Chain at guitar.solutions.

records.title: 9 iOS apps, 6 Android apps and 2 Chrome extensions
records.body: Jason has shipped 9 iOS apps under his own Apple developer account, plus 6 Android apps on Google Play and 2 Chrome extensions. These are platform listings; the Android editions overlap the iOS products. Suede AI Visibility and Suede Sing are the two Chrome Web Store extensions.

records.title: More than 30 sites, and a published app family
records.body: Jason builds and operates the Suede estate: AI agent platforms first (Suede AI Agent Studio and Agentix), the Suede AI SEO practice and Suede Scan, developer infrastructure, and, as a separate product line, music and creator software such as Suede AI Studio, Suede AI Distro, Strumly, Suede Muse, Suede Social and Suede DNA. That is more than 30 live sites. Nine apps are published under Jason Colapietro’s Apple developer account. Eighteen owned brand domains carry a single canonical entity, entered at jasoncolapietro.com. The wider company portfolio includes FretPulse under its separate FretPulse LLC seller account.

records.title: Agent flows that ship as x402 endpoints settling in USDC on Base
records.body: Suede AI Agent Studio lets a builder draw an agent as a node graph and launch it as an x402 pay-per-call endpoint settling in USDC on Base, with Agentix tracking per-call earnings. The work implements the x402 protocol and ERC-8004 and includes a merged fix in the x402 Foundation’s own repository. It builds on those standards as an implementer, not a standards author.

records.title: Member of Claude for Startups
records.body: Suede AI has been a member of Claude for Startups, Anthropic’s startup program, since October 8, 2026. It is a startup-program membership, not a partnership.

records.title: Member of Google Cloud Partner Advantage
records.body: JC Investment Group LLC has been a member of Google Cloud Partner Advantage since September 4, 2026, with suedeai.ai as the verified domain. The membership is a second milestone in the partnership with Google Cloud that began in September 2025.

records.title: Google Cloud and the Vertex AI suite
records.body: Suede has worked in partnership with Google Cloud since September 2025, with a dedicated account team, a Google Premier Partner assigned to support the account, and migration of the stack onto the Vertex AI suite, including Gemini, Vertex AI Agent Builder, and Veo. The account team’s published quote calls Suede an ideal partner for promoting the Vertex suite.

records.title: Admitted to Stripe Startups
records.body: Suede AI was admitted to Stripe Startups in July 2026. It is a program admission; no investment is implied.

records.title: Five provisional patent applications
records.body: Five USPTO provisional patent applications are on file: 63/946,189, 63/946,192, 63/946,212, 63/946,217 and 63/947,120. Status: patent pending (provisional). These are applications, not granted patents.

records.title: Florida Atlantic Entrepreneurship Institute and 1909
records.body: Jason was accepted into the Florida Atlantic Entrepreneurship Institute at FAU’s College of Business in July 2026, and is a member of 1909, the entrepreneurship hub in West Palm Beach.

records.title: Wikidata and Crunchbase entries, plus an Apple-hosted developer page
records.body: Third-party records describe Jason independently of anything Suede publishes: a Wikidata item, a Crunchbase founder profile, and Apple’s developer page listing nine shipped apps under his name. One person carries two public names, Jason Colapietro and Johnny Suede, and every surface states the linkage rather than letting them drift into separate records.

records.title: Founder and CEO of Suede AI; Manager of JC Investment Group LLC
records.body: Jason is the founder and CEO of Suede AI, an agentic platform company that builds and runs AI agent platforms businesses use to manage their work, and white-labels them for agencies and their clients. He is also the listed manager of JC Investment Group LLC, organized in Florida in 2019 under document L19000146068. suedeai.org is Suede AI’s research and investor site.

records.title: Built, ran, and sold call centers
records.body: Before Suede, Jason Colapietro built, ran, and sold call centers. That operating experience now informs Suede’s managed agents for call review, lead qualification, and sales-script consistency.

records.title: The method, the research, and the tools are public
records.body: Suede publishes the full method behind its GEO practice in The Screenshot and the Founder’s Checklist. The company blog includes original research such as the AI Crawler Access Index, alongside engineering essays and creator-rights guides. Jason also publishes independently on Substack, and releases reusable developer skills through Suede’s public repositories.

records.title: Thirteen placements across seven outlets
records.body: Gigawatt Group, MSN, Markets Insider (FinanceWire press release), TechBullion, Programming Insider, Altcoin Investor, and Indie Hackers have published coverage, announcements and founder essays about Suede AI. The record includes Gigawatt Group’s September 2026 comparison of Suede AI’s managed GEO practice with Profound, the SEO and AI cohort carried by MSN and announced in a FinanceWire press release on Markets Insider, the on-chain IP authentication launch, the iOS and developer-tool launches, advancing in the Avalanche Build Games, the IP visibility audit, and self-funded education deployments in African classrooms. Two placements are Jason’s bylined essays.

records.title: Mario Nawfal posts and Crypto Roundtable AMA
records.body: Mario Nawfal featured Suede in two public posts eight months apart. The Suede AI AMA also ran on his Crypto Roundtable. The posts discuss creator control, ownership, and a voice signature that can travel with the work.

records.title: Best Overall + Best API Option — AI Agents Directory, 52+ music tools
records.body: Suede AI holds both top-pick positions in AI Agents Directory's music category. The live category lists 52+ music tools.

records.title: Best Overall and Best API Option
records.body: The AI Agents Directory music-category capture names Suede AI Best Overall and Best API Option among 47 tools, with a 5.0-star listing. The archived record and the live category page are linked separately so readers can distinguish the recorded recognition from today’s directory.

records.title: Named in a proposed Community Note
records.body: Suede Labs was named as an opt-out option in a proposed Community Note shown in a screenshot Elon Musk posted. The mention is the note’s wording, not an endorsement.

records.title: A dated Google Web Guide capture
records.body: On September 6, 2026, Google’s Web Guide, the AI-organized results layer inside Google Search, answered the query “Suede labs ai review” with: “Suede Labs AI is highly rated by users, earning a 5/5 rating from verified reviews,” citing two App Store listings. The quote is Google’s model summarizing App Store ratings, not an audited review score. Dated model output, not an endorsement or a ranking Google issued.

records.body: In a February 2026 capture, Gemini placed Suede in a “New Big 3” of AI music platforms beside Suno and Udio, describing it as “The Creator’s IP Fortress.” A separate March session discusses Jason’s experience and Suede’s architecture. Dated model output, not an endorsement or a ranking Google issued.
